title: ‘Human Centipede’ Director Tom Six Addresses Career Collapse, Impending Death: “These Are My Final Words” (Exclusive)
summary: The provoc-auteur discusses the new documentary chronicling his seven-year fight to get 'The Onania Club' distributed and his struggles with MS, life as a "short, sadistic joke," and staring into the abyss with your hands on fire while your head is still full of ideas.
